newsitem.title: USA: Echlin says buys Moto Mirror for $18 mln.
newsitem.headline: Echlin says buys Moto Mirror for $18 mln.

text.p: Echlin Inc said on Friday it bought the outstanding shares of remote-control mirror manufacturer Moto Mirror Inc in a stock swap valued at $18 million.
Moto Mirror had annual sales of around $16 million in 1995 and Echlin bought its shares in a pooling of interests transaction, the company said in a statement.

"Moto Mirror is an excellent addition to our product line for heavy duty vehicles, which includes brake systems, clutches, starters, windshield wiper systems, HVAC controls, air suspension products, window lift systems, electrical connectors, trailer draw bars and air horns," Echlin Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Frederick Mancheski said in a statement.
